permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Sends what you say to the Duet server, which turns it into text and asks Claude for the answer.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Hears "Hey Duet" and your questions while Duet is open. Only speech is sent, never silence, and nothing is stored.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Lets Duet answer "what's the weather" or "what's near me". Rounded to about 10 km and never stored.
